task: MASSIVE 1.0 zh-CN four-slot copy-only JSON extraction

analysis.entity_match: multiset of (type, literal value) per utterance

invalid_schema.definition: JSON parsed but did not meet the strict slot schema, including duplicate object keys.

invalid_copy.definition: Schema passed but at least one value was not a literal source substring.

missed_all_gold_slots.definition: Gold has slots and zero exact (type, value) multiset matches; includes invalid outputs.

missed_all_gold_slots_valid_output.definition: Same as missed_all_gold_slots, restricted to valid outputs.

extra_slots_on_gold_empty.definition: Valid output contains slots when gold contains none.

type_confusion_same_value.definition: After exact matching, the same literal value appears under different gold and predicted types.

same_type_different_value.definition: After exact matching, an unmatched gold and predicted slot share a type but have different literal values; this is a possible value mismatch, not a proven entity alignment.

possible_span_boundary_mismatch.definition: A subset of same_type_different_value where one literal value contains the other; source occurrence offsets are not aligned.

partial_correct.definition: A valid output matches at least one gold slot exactly and still has false positives or false negatives.

duplicate_slot_output.definition: A valid output repeats a (type, value) pair; this can be correct when gold repeats it too.

excess_duplicate_slot.definition: A valid output repeats a (type, value) pair more times than gold, with at least two copies.

fully_correct.definition: A valid output exactly equals the gold slot multiset.

incorrect.definition: Not fully correct; includes invalid outputs.
